evals.name: produces-draft-analysis-plan-from-normalized-document
evals.description: Verifies that the skill uses the document-structure-analysis public interface to analyze an existing normalized-source-document and produce a draft analysis-plan for human review.
evals.prompt: Use the analyze-document-structure skill on a normalized-source-document v1 dict produced by extraction. Describe what the skill should call and what output contract it should return.
expected: Consumes an existing normalized-source-document v1 dict
Leaves confirmation.status as draft for human review
Does not parse DOCX files or render output

evals.name: keeps-analysis-boundaries-distinct
evals.description: Verifies that the skill respects plugin boundaries: it reasons over extracted observations, recommends topic/chunking structure, and does not assemble, publish, or mutate content.
evals.prompt: Use the analyze-document-structure skill after source extraction. Explain what responsibilities stay inside this skill and what must be handled by downstream plugins.
expected: Identifies heading hierarchy and topic boundaries from extracted observations
Proposes chunking strategy and stable structural anchors
Does not assemble the structured content package
Does not mutate the input document
